english.title: Holder of art 205 / 206 approval fail to cause to be produced docs / records relating to air traffic service equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of an approval under article 205 or 206 of the Air Navigation Order 2016, failed, within a reasonable time after being requested to do so by **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an authorised person, to cause to be produced to that person documents and records relating to air traffic service equipment used or intended to be used in connection with the provision of a service to an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 236 and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
